title: Food Portions
subtitle: 「食物份量」，究竟是哪一種「每份／每餐的量」？
description: 「食物份量」，究竟是哪一種「每份／每餐的量」？

words.note: 最直接、最自然的替換之一，表示一次提供或建議食用的食物份量大小。
words.example: The restaurant reduced serving sizes to cut food waste.
words.exampleZh: 餐廳縮小每份食物的份量，以減少食物浪費。

exercises.original: The restaurant reduced its food portions to cut waste.
exercises.zh: 餐廳縮小食物份量，以減少浪費。
exercises.upgrade: serving sizes · 食物份量；每份大小

options.explanation: meal size = 可能指整餐總量，但原句重點是每份供應量。
calories = 減少 calories 和縮小份量不是完全同一件事。
serving sizes = reduced ... to cut waste 表示每份供應的食物量變小，因此 serving sizes 最自然。
plates = 餐盤不是份量本身。
quality = 不是食物多少。
service = 不是 serving。

exercises.original: Large food portions can encourage people to eat more than they need.
exercises.zh: 過大的食物份量可能令人吃得超過需要。
exercises.upgrade: serving sizes · 食物份量；每份大小

options.explanation: calorie counts = 熱量可能增加，但本句首先談視覺和實際份量。
meal quality = 不是食物多少。
serving dishes = 器皿大小不是內容量本身。
serving sizes = 份量大小會影響進食量，serving sizes 是最直接的營養語境表達。
nutrition levels = 不合。
plate numbers = 不合。

exercises.original: The school reviewed food portions for younger and older students.
exercises.zh: 學校檢視年幼和年長學生的食物份量。
exercises.upgrade: serving sizes · 食物份量；每份大小

options.explanation: meal schedules = 不是時間安排。
calories = 可能同時檢視，但不等於份量。
nutrition = 太廣。
plates = 不合。
serving sizes = 不同年齡組需要不同每份大小，因此 serving sizes 最貼切。
service quality = 不合。

words.note: 描述性說法，強調一餐中提供或食用的食物總量。
words.example: The dietitian adjusted meal quantities according to each patient's needs.
words.exampleZh: 營養師按每名病人的需要調整餐點份量。

exercises.original: The dietitian adjusted food portions according to each patient's needs.
exercises.zh: 營養師按每名病人的需要調整餐點份量。
exercises.upgrade: meal quantities · 餐點份量；用餐分量

options.explanation: meal quality = 不是多少。
calories = 可能相關但未必只調熱量。
plates = 不是食物量。
meal quantities = 按患者需要調整一餐中實際食物總量，meal quantities 很自然。
servings = 可用，但本句強調整餐總量。
nutrition = 不是分量。

exercises.original: The hospital monitors food portions for patients with reduced appetites.
exercises.zh: 醫院會監察食慾較低病人的餐點份量。
exercises.upgrade: meal quantities · 餐點份量；用餐分量

options.explanation: meal times = 不是用餐時間。
food quality = 不是多少。
serving dishes = 不合。
calorie labels = 不是本句重點。
meal quantities = reduced appetites 對應一餐食物總量，因此 meal quantities 最精確。
nutrition plans = 範圍更廣。

exercises.original: Food portions were increased for athletes during the training camp.
exercises.zh: 訓練營期間，運動員的餐點份量有所增加。
exercises.upgrade: meal quantities · 餐點份量；用餐分量

options.explanation: plate sizes = 餐盤大不等於食物一定多。
calories = 可能上升，但不是直接同義。
quality = 不合。
service = 不合。
meal frequency = 不是每餐量。
meal quantities = 運動員訓練期間增加每餐實際食物量，meal quantities 很貼切。

words.note: 非常常見，尤其用於營養、飲食控制、餐廳和包裝食品語境，與 food portions 非常接近。
words.example: Portion sizes have increased in many restaurants over the years.
words.exampleZh: 多年來，很多餐廳的食物份量都有增加。

exercises.original: Researchers measured food portions served in different restaurants.
exercises.zh: 研究人員量度不同餐廳提供的食物份量。
exercises.upgrade: portion sizes · 份量大小

options.explanation: plate sizes = 可以影響 portion，但不是被量度的食物量。
calorie values = 不是體積或重量本身。
meal quality = 不合。
serving dishes = 不合。
portion sizes = 研究餐廳實際提供多少食物，最標準的說法是 portion sizes。
service levels = 不合。

exercises.original: The guide recommends smaller food portions for high-energy snacks.
exercises.zh: 指南建議高能量零食採用較小份量。
exercises.upgrade: portion sizes · 份量大小

options.explanation: meal quantities = snacks 不一定算整餐。
calorie labels = 不是建議份量。
plate portions = 不一定裝在餐盤。
nutrition quality = 不合。
serving dishes = 不合。
portion sizes = 零食的一次食用份量大小，portion sizes 最自然。

exercises.original: Food portions have become larger over the past twenty years.
exercises.zh: 過去二十年食物份量變得更大。
exercises.upgrade: portion sizes · 份量大小

options.explanation: portion sizes = 描述長期餐飲份量變大的趨勢，常用 portion sizes。
meal schedules = 不合。
plate numbers = 不合。
nutrition levels = 不是大小。
calories = 未必所有食物熱量都按同樣比例上升。
quality = 不合。

words.note: 表示一次供應或食用的一個標準份量；也常見於營養標籤和食譜。
words.exampleZh: 這個包裝包含四份食物。

exercises.original: The package contains four food portions.
exercises.zh: 這個包裝包含四份食物。
exercises.upgrade: servings · 每份；一份食物

options.explanation: meals = 四份不一定是四餐。
plates = 包裝不包含餐盤。
calories = 是能量數值。
portions sizes = 語法錯誤且不是可數份數。
service = 不合。
servings = 包裝中可分成幾份來食用，標準營養標籤用詞是 servings。

exercises.original: One food portion provides about fifteen grams of protein.
exercises.zh: 一份食物提供約十五克蛋白質。
exercises.upgrade: servings · 每份；一份食物

options.explanation: servings = One serving provides... 是營養標籤和食譜的典型結構。
meal = 可能太大，不一定是一整餐。
plate = 不是內容量。
quantity = 太抽象且少了標準份量概念。
service = 字形相近但意思不同。
calorie = 不合 protein grams。

exercises.original: The recipe makes six food portions.
exercises.zh: 這個食譜可做六份。
exercises.upgrade: servings · 每份；一份食物

options.explanation: meal quantities = 不是可數的 finished portions。
servings = 食譜產出可供多少人食用的份數，最自然說 six servings。
plates = 不等於食物份數。
calories = 不合。
services = 意思完全不同。
qualities = 不合。

words.note: 最一般、最容易理解的描述性說法，強調實際提供或吃下的食物量。
words.example: The study compared the amounts of food eaten at lunch and dinner.
words.exampleZh: 研究比較了午餐和晚餐的食物攝取量。

exercises.original: The study compared food portions eaten at lunch and dinner.
exercises.zh: 研究比較午餐和晚餐實際吃下的食物量。
exercises.upgrade: amounts of food · 食物量；食物份量

options.explanation: amounts of food = 如果只想一般描述實際吃了多少食物，amounts of food 最清楚。
meal quality = 不是多少。
calories = 只是食物量的一種可能衡量方式。
plate sizes = 不是攝取量本身。
serving dishes = 不合。
nutrition = 太廣。

exercises.original: Children were offered different food portions depending on age.
exercises.zh: 兒童按年齡獲提供不同食物量。
exercises.upgrade: amounts of food · 食物量；食物份量

options.explanation: qualities of food = 不是多少。
amounts of food = 按 age 改變的是實際食物量，因此 amounts of food 是自然描述。
plates = 不合。
calories = 未必按 calories 分配。
meal times = 不合。
services = 不合。

exercises.original: We recorded the food portions left on each plate after the meal.
exercises.zh: 我們記錄每餐後每個餐盤剩下的食物量。
exercises.upgrade: amounts of food · 食物量；食物份量

options.explanation: plate sizes = 不是盤子大小。
servings = 剩餘物未必正好是一個標準 serving。
amounts of food = 剩餘量未必符合標準份量，因此一般說 amounts of food 最準確。
calorie counts = 可以估算但原句只說 amount。
nutrition = 不合。
service = 不合。

words.note: 強調某一餐中分配或提供的食物份量，常見於餐飲、醫院和學校膳食語境。
words.example: The kitchen prepares smaller meal portions for younger children.
words.exampleZh: 廚房會為年幼兒童準備較小的餐點份量。

exercises.original: The kitchen prepares smaller food portions for younger children.
exercises.zh: 廚房會為年幼兒童準備較小的餐點份量。
exercises.upgrade: meal portions · 餐點份量

options.explanation: serving dishes = 不是器皿。
meal portions = 這裡明確是每餐供應給兒童的份量，因此 meal portions 很自然。
calories = 不是唯一衡量方式。
meal schedules = 不是時間。
food quality = 不合。
plates = 不合。

exercises.original: Staff checked food portions before the trays were sent to patients.
exercises.zh: 餐盤送給病人前，員工先檢查餐點份量。
exercises.upgrade: meal portions · 餐點份量

options.explanation: meal times = 不合。
plate sizes = trays 大小不等於內容量。
meal portions = 醫院 trays 上每餐分配多少食物，meal portions 最貼切。
serving dishes = 不合。
nutrition plans = 太廣。
quality = 未必是品質檢查。

exercises.original: The programme provides larger food portions after intense training sessions.
exercises.zh: 計劃在高強度訓練後提供較大的餐點份量。
exercises.upgrade: meal portions · 餐點份量

options.explanation: meal frequencies = 不是用餐次數。
calories = 可能較高但不是同義。
plates = 不合。
meal portions = 高強度訓練後調整整餐份量，meal portions 很自然。
service quality = 不合。
nutrition labels = 不合。

words.note: 較直接，表示一份份被提供或計算的食物，常見於膳食計劃和營養建議。
words.example: The programme recommends five small food servings throughout the day.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃建議一天分五次食用小份食物。

exercises.original: The plan divides the daily intake into five small food portions.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃把每日攝取量分成五小份食物。
exercises.upgrade: food servings · 食物份量；每份食物

options.explanation: meal sizes = 五小份未必是五餐。
plates = 不合。
food servings = 每日 intake 被分成數個小份，food servings 清楚表示每一份食物。
calories = 不是份數。
quality levels = 不合。
serving dishes = 不合。

exercises.original: The event provided individual food portions for every participant.
exercises.zh: 活動為每名參加者提供獨立食物份量。
exercises.upgrade: food servings · 食物份量；每份食物

options.explanation: meal quantities = 較像總量概念，不如 servings 表達逐份分配。
plates = 不是器皿重點。
calories = 不合。
food servings = individual ... for every participant 強調一人一份，因此 food servings 最自然。
nutrition = 不合。
service = 不合。

exercises.original: The nutrition guide shows examples of standard food portions.
exercises.zh: 營養指南展示標準食物份量例子。
exercises.upgrade: food servings · 食物份量；每份食物

options.explanation: meal quality = 不合。
serving dishes = 不合。
plate numbers = 不合。
calorie totals = 未必只是熱量。
food servings = 營養指南中的 standard units 可自然稱為 food servings。
services = 字形相近但意思不同。

words.note: 較描述性，表示實際盛給一個人的食物量，和 serving size 意思非常接近。
words.example: Staff were trained to keep serving portions consistent.
words.exampleZh: 員工接受培訓，以保持每份食物量一致。

exercises.original: The cafeteria tries to keep food portions consistent throughout the day.
exercises.zh: 自助餐廳盡量令全日每份食物量保持一致。
exercises.upgrade: serving portions · 每份食物量；供應份量

options.explanation: meal times = 不合。
service quality = 不是餐飲服務質素。
plates = 不合。
serving portions = 每次盛出的量要一致，serving portions 能突出實際供應份量。
calorie labels = 不是一致的唯一標準。
meal frequency = 不合。

exercises.original: Staff use standard scoops so that food portions do not vary too much.
exercises.zh: 員工使用標準量勺，以免每份食物量相差太大。
exercises.upgrade: serving portions · 每份食物量；供應份量

options.explanation: plate sizes = 量勺控制的是食物量。
meal quality = 不合。
serving dishes = 不是盛菜的大盤。
calories = 未必直接控制熱量。
serving portions = standard scoops 用來控制每次盛出的量，因此 serving portions 很精確。
services = 不合。

exercises.original: The caterer adjusted food portions after learning the final guest numbers.
exercises.zh: 餐飲供應商得知最終賓客人數後調整每份食物量。
exercises.upgrade: serving portions · 每份食物量；供應份量

options.explanation: meal schedules = 不是時間。
food quality = 不合。
plates = 不合。
nutrition values = 不是唯一調整項。
service levels = 不合。
serving portions = caterer 根據 guest numbers 改變每人供應量，serving portions 很自然。

words.note: 常見於營養標籤和飲食指引，表示建議一次食用的標準份量。
words.example: The label lists a suggested serving size of thirty grams.
words.exampleZh: 標籤列出的建議食用份量是三十克。

exercises.original: The label states that the food portion is thirty grams.
exercises.zh: 標籤列明建議食用份量是三十克。
exercises.upgrade: suggested serving size · 建議食用份量

options.explanation: meal quantity = 包裝標籤通常不用整餐 quantity 表達。
plate portion = 不一定涉及餐盤。
calorie amount = 三十克是重量，不是 calories。
serving dish = 不合。
suggested serving size = label + thirty grams 是典型包裝建議份量語境，因此 suggested serving size 最準確。
food quality = 不合。

exercises.original: Consumers often eat more than the food portion shown on the package.
exercises.zh: 消費者往往吃得比包裝所示建議份量更多。
exercises.upgrade: suggested serving size · 建議食用份量

options.explanation: meal quality = 不合。
serving dish = 不合。
calorie total = 不是包裝所示的份量單位本身。
plate size = 不是 package label。
service = 不合。
suggested serving size = 包裝上列出的標準一次食用量，就是 suggested serving size。

exercises.original: The nutrition panel gives one cup as the food portion for this product.
exercises.zh: 營養標籤把一杯列為這款產品的建議食用份量。
exercises.upgrade: suggested serving size · 建議食用份量

options.explanation: suggested serving size = nutrition panel 使用的是標準 serving-size 概念，因此這個改寫最自然。
meal portion = 可理解但 label 語境更專門是 serving size。
plate portion = 不合。
food quality = 不合。
calorie count = one cup 不是 calorie count。
serving dish = 不合。

words.note: 表示基於營養、健康或飲食指引而建議的一次食用量。
words.example: The recommended portion for this cereal is one small bowl.
words.exampleZh: 這款穀物早餐的建議份量是一小碗。

exercises.original: The dietitian explained the ideal food portion for the cereal.
exercises.zh: 營養師解釋這款穀物早餐的建議份量。
exercises.upgrade: recommended portion · 建議份量

options.explanation: meal quantity = 較泛。
serving dish = 不合。
calorie label = 不合。
plate size = 不合。
quality = 不合。
recommended portion = 由 dietitian 根據飲食建議提供的份量，最自然稱 recommended portion。

exercises.original: The guide says that a food portion of nuts should be relatively small.
exercises.zh: 指南指出堅果的建議份量應較小。
exercises.upgrade: recommended portion · 建議份量

options.explanation: recommended portion = 健康指南對某種食物提出建議的一次食用量，recommended portion 最精確。
meal portion = nuts 通常只是一餐中的一部分。
plate portion = 不一定放在餐盤。
serving dish = 不合。
calorie count = 不是同義。
meal size = 範圍太大。

exercises.original: Patients were shown the correct food portions for each food group.
exercises.zh: 病人獲示範每個食物組別的建議份量。
exercises.upgrade: recommended portion · 建議份量

options.explanation: meal quantities = 較像整餐總量。
recommended portion = 每個 food group 的健康建議量，recommended portions 很自然。
plates = 不合。
calorie values = 不是每組食物的實際份量概念。
service sizes = 字詞錯誤。
nutrition quality = 不合。

words.note: 當重點是餐盤上各類食物所佔的實際份量時適用，常見於健康飲食教育。
words.example: The guide shows how to balance plate portions of vegetables, protein, and grains.
words.exampleZh: 指南示範如何平衡餐盤上蔬菜、蛋白質和穀物的份量。

exercises.original: The diet guide explains how to divide food portions among vegetables, protein, and grains.
exercises.zh: 飲食指南說明如何分配餐盤上蔬菜、蛋白質和穀物的份量。
exercises.upgrade: plate portions · 餐盤份量；盤中分量

options.explanation: plate portions = 同一餐盤上各 food groups 的份量分配，plate portions 最貼切。
servings = 可算份數，但本句是同一 plate 上各類所佔份量。
meal quantities = 太整體。
plate sizes = 不是餐盤直徑。
calories = 不是各食物類別所佔實際份量。
serving dishes = 不合。

exercises.original: The programme teaches children to balance food portions on their plates.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃教兒童平衡餐盤上的食物份量。
exercises.upgrade: plate portions · 餐盤份量；盤中分量

options.explanation: meal times = 不合。
plate portions = 重點就是 plate 上各類食物的比例和量，因此 plate portions 很自然。
serving dishes = 不是器皿選擇。
calories = 不是唯一平衡方式。
meal quality = 不合。
services = 不合。

exercises.original: Photographs were used to compare food portions on different plates.
exercises.zh: 研究使用照片比較不同餐盤上的食物份量。
exercises.upgrade: plate portions · 餐盤份量；盤中分量

options.explanation: plate sizes = 照片可能顯示盤子大小，但原句要比較盤中食物量。
meal quality = 不合。
plate portions = 以 photographs 比較不同 plate 上實際食物量，用 plate portions 很合適。
serving dishes = 不合。
calorie labels = 照片不能直接顯示精確 calories。
services = 不合。

words.note: 較正式、技術性，常見於食品標籤、餐飲標準或產品規格。
words.example: The manufacturer reduced the quantity per serving without changing the package size.
words.exampleZh: 製造商在不改變包裝大小的情況下減少了每份食物量。

exercises.original: The manufacturer reduced the food portion without changing the package size.
exercises.zh: 製造商在不改變包裝大小的情況下減少每份食物量。
exercises.upgrade: quantity per serving · 每份數量；每份食物量

options.explanation: meal quantity = 產品包裝未必是一餐。
quantity per serving = 產品規格中每一 serving 實際包含多少，正式可稱 quantity per serving。
plate portion = 不合包裝規格。
serving dish = 不合。
calorie quality = 不合。
meal frequency = 不合。

exercises.original: The specification lists the food portion for each individual pack.
exercises.zh: 規格列明每個獨立包裝的每份數量。
exercises.upgrade: quantity per serving · 每份數量；每份食物量

options.explanation: meal size = 不一定是一餐。
plate size = 不合。
quantity per serving = specification + individual pack 是技術產品語境，因此 quantity per serving 最精確。
service quantity = service 不是 serving。
food quality = 不合。
calorie level = 未必只列熱量。

exercises.original: The company increased the food portion slightly in the new version of the product.
exercises.zh: 公司在新版產品中略微增加了每份食物量。
exercises.upgrade: quantity per serving · 每份數量；每份食物量

options.explanation: meal portion = 產品未必作完整 meal。
plate portion = 不合。
serving dish = 不合。
quantity per serving = 產品版本之間比較每份內容量，quantity per serving 是清楚正式的說法。
quality per serving = 不是數量。
service size = 字詞錯誤。

falseSynonyms.zh: 一餐大小不一定等於每份食物份量 meal size 指整餐的總量；food portion 可以只指餐中的一項食物或一份標準量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A meal may contain several food portions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 熱量不等於食物份量 calories 表示能量；兩份體積相同的食物可以含有完全不同的熱量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Portion size and calorie content are related, but they are not the same thing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 營養不等於份量 nutrition 指營養成分或營養狀況；food portions 指實際食物量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A small portion can still be highly nutritious.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餐盤不等於份量 plate 是盛載食物的器皿；它的大小可能影響份量，但不是份量本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A large plate may encourage a larger portion, but the plate is not the portion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 盛食物的器皿不等於一份食物 serving dish 是用來盛食物的盤或碗；serving 是一份食物量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The serving dish holds several servings.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字形相近但意思不同 portion 是一部分或一份食物；proportion 是比例。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The portion was small. The proportion of vegetables was high.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字形相近但意思不同 serving 可指一份食物；service 指服務。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON One serving contains 200 calories. The restaurant provides good service.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數量不等於品質 quantity 指多少；quality 指好壞程度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A meal can be small in quantity but high in quality.
